item.title: The DeBonis Family: From Italy to America
item.description: Introduction In 1936, my great-great-grandfather Emmanuele de Bonis, shot the town sheriff in the village of Miglionico. And so, in 1936, my great-great-grandfather Emmanuele de Bonis, along with his son (my great-grandfather), Michelangelo de Bonis (who was only 12 years old at the time, and will hereout be referred to as the anglicized ‘Michael’), left Italy on a ship to America. According to Ravenstein’s laws of migration, the de Bonis family’s motivations for leaving Italy, although unorthodox, would be categorized as push forces.
